title: <Category of skill (e.g., Runbook, Rulebook, Doc Template). short and slightly descriptive, optimized for human display and understanding. less than 65 chars>
description: <One-or-two-sentence description of what skill family this schema represents>

aip.version: <0.1 for new schemas, otherwise iterate version from previous schema>
aip.tag: <optional — schema-family-tag-for-discovery; omit this line if not used>

purpose.description: What the skill encapsulates as a coherent unit of work — the scope it covers and what it adds beyond general agent knowledge. One short paragraph.

trigger_when.description: Conditions under which the agent should consider this skill. Mixed granularity expected — immediate invocation triggers (e.g., 'user asks to add functionality') alongside broader applicability contexts (e.g., 'evaluating technology choices') belong in the same list.

do_not_use_when.description: Optional. Conditions under which the agent should NOT use this skill — explicit non-purposes that pair with trigger_when to sharpen activation. Helps the agent calibrate when adjacent skills or general reasoning would serve better.

anti_patterns.description: Optional. Common mistakes the skill steers the agent away from. Concrete corrections to errors the agent would otherwise make.
